Run a full security audit of this repository. This is an explicit end-to-end security audit: use full audit mode and write the report artifacts.

Profile: quick.
Scope paths: server/ and deploy/ only. Record every other path as out of scope.
Budget: 16 agent invocations.
Skill directory: the absolute path of third-party/security-audit-skill/skills/security-audit in this checkout.
Target: this repository root.
Output directory: __AUDIT_OUTPUT__
This output directory is outside the repository. Write run-metadata.json, architecture.md, coverage-ledger.json, findings.json, REPORT.md, FINDINGS-DETAIL.md, and NEEDS-VALIDATION.md only there.

Do not modify, commit, or push any file in the repository. Do not probe deployed or shared services. Use Node for validate-findings.cjs and validate-coverage-ledger.cjs. If the runner cannot provide the required OS sandbox, leave runtime checks as needs_validation instead of executing target code.
